name: 78520 · Brownsville, TX
findings: ZIP 78520 (Brownsville) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78520 (Brownsville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78520 (Brownsville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
